a: IA organizes content so users can find what they need.
Show advanced options only when needed.
Larger, closer targets are faster to acquire.
More choices can increase decision time.
Controls should look actionable and confirm actions.
Keep navigation patterns stable across screens.
Validate fields near the input with clear messages.
Skeletons reduce perceived wait during loading.
Avoid manipulative UI that tricks users.
Design for diverse abilities, languages, and contexts.
